title: Understanding SVD
text: In Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), the matrix $S$ contains the singular values. These values are related to the variance captured by each principal component.

title: Total Variance
text: The total variance is the sum of the squares of the singular values in $S$. Calculate this sum to find the total variance.

title: Calculate Total Variance
text: Calculate the total variance by summing the squares of the singular values: $10**2$, $2**2$, and $0.1**2$.

title: Variance Captured by PC1
text: The variance captured by the first principal component (PC1) is the square of the first singular value.

title: Calculate Variance for PC1
text: Calculate the variance captured by PC1 using the first singular value: $10**2$.

title: Proportion of Variance
text: The proportion of variance captured by PC1 is the variance of PC1 divided by the total variance.

title: Calculate Proportion of Variance
text: Calculate the proportion of variance captured by PC1: $100/104.01$.
